notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Chain Stasis targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
 Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Chain Stasis, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and choosing not to copy Chain Stasis.
Repeat from step 3.
